_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 17 = FALA (aula impar) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): frases clivadas para dar enfase (What I love about it is... / It's the ... that ... / All I want is... / The thing that...). Era a aula 11 do desenho original; volta na ordem do curriculo. Tema bloco C (comida); fato dono: acai. Video em aula (YouTube nocookie, Tess Begg). Visual juvenil inline. Vozes iguais as aulas 1-16.

lesson.grammar_point: cleft sentences for emphasis: what-clefts (What I love about it is...), it-clefts (It's the ... that ...), all I want is...

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby! I'm at the acai place near school, and they have a new bowl. What I love about it is the peanut butter on top. And it's the banana that makes it so sweet, not sugar. The only problem is the size. It's huge! All I need now is someone to share it with. So, are you coming? What I don't want is to eat it all alone!
